user.title: Connect to Quitoque
user.description:
**Quitoque notifications**

• **New editable box**: alert when a new order becomes available for recipe selection (existing orders do not trigger an initial alert).
• **Deadline reminder**: alert 1 to 7 days before the estimated deadline, currently calculated as 6 days before delivery at 11:59 PM.
• **Delivery**: Home Assistant, mobile, or both. Push texts support delivery date, deadline, and order ID.

**Other options**: calendar recipe import (W0 to W+4), PDF generation and retention.

data_description.notify_deadline_days: Choose 1 to 7 days before the estimated cutoff. Only applies when reminders are enabled.
data_description.notify_mobile_new_message: Customize the notification text. Message placeholders: delivery date (delivery_date), deadline (deadline_date), and order ID (order_id).
data_description.notify_mobile_deadline_message: Customize the notification text. Message placeholders: delivery date (delivery_date), deadline (deadline_date), and order ID (order_id).
data_description.notify_new_order: Notify when a new order becomes available for recipe selection. Existing orders do not trigger alerts on first startup.
data_description.notify_before_deadline: Send a reminder before the estimated cutoff for editing box recipes.
data_description.reminder_send_time: Home Assistant local time (default 08:00). Example: 3 days before the deadline at 08:00.
